correctness.rationale: Reconstructed primitive normal form X~J2(0) direct sum [c], c^2=0 from nonzero mod-pi residue and basis splitting; primitive conjugation fibers have invertible centralizers of size q^(5m-2)(q-1)^2, giving P_m=N(q)q^[4(m-1)+floor(m/2)]. Every nonprimitive solution is pi times a matrix modulo length m-1 whose square vanishes modulo m-2, yielding F_m=P_m+q^9F_(m-2), F0=1 and F1=1+N(q). Independently exhaustive 4^9 matrices over Z/4Z and F2[t]/t^2 both give F2=1184. For geometry, each exact valuation-j stratum is an irreducible affine fibration over primitive length m-2j and has common dimension 4m+floor(m/2); even deep linear locus is separate, odd deep locus is specialized from S_h via s*J+t*Z. The proof establishes reduced geometric components, not scheme multiplicities.

Published related generic-reducedness and 2x2 chain-ring results do not imply all m 3x3 component census.
